title: Epigallocatechin-3-gallate inhibit the protein arginine methyltransferase 5 and enhancer of Zeste homolog 2 in breast cancer both in vitro and in vivo.
authors: Nalla, Kirankumar; Chatterjee, Biji; Poyya, Jagadeesha; Swain, Aishwarya; Ghosh, Krishna; Pan, Archana; Joshi, Chandrashekhar G; Manavathi, Bramanandam; Kanade, Santosh R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究EGCG通过分子对接和实验抑制PRMT5/EZH2甲基转移酶，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接辅助，与TF-DNA课题关联弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Histone methyltransferases are enzymes that selectively methylate lysine or arginine residues on both histone and non-histone proteins, categorized into lysine methyltransferases and arginine methyltransferases. Notably, EZH2 and PRMT5 are known for catalyzing trimethylation of H3 at K27 and symmetric dimethylation of H4 at R3, respectively. These methylation events are recognized as characteristic histone-repressive marks in cancer. The over expression of PRMT5 and EZH2 were reported in various cancers and recognized as a drug target. The study aims to explore the inhibitory potential of phytocompound, Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG), against PRMT5 and EZH2 in the breast cancer model. METHODS: Screening of an array of phytocompounds was conducted through a combination of in-silico and in-vitro assays. Interactions between EGCG and human PRMT5: MEP50 and EZH2 were evaluated using molecular docking. Binding efficiency was validated, by Surface Plasmon Resonance studies and inhibitory potential was accessed by in vitro methylation followed by western blots, ELISA, and cell-based assays. In-vivo efficacy of EGCG was carried on cell line derived mice xenograft model. RESULTS: EGCG demonstrated robust interactions with PRMT5:MEP50 complex and EZH2, particularly within the SAM binding site. Surface Plasmon Resonance analysis revealed strong binding affinity in nanomolar concentrations, particularly with PRMT5-MEP50 compared to EZH2. In-vitro assays confirmed EGCG's ability to inhibit PRMT5 and EZH2, leading to a decrease in their catalytic products, namely H4R3me2s and H3K27me3, respectively. EGCG treatment induced both autophagy and apoptosis invitro. In-vivo studies demonstrated significant reductions in tumor size and the proliferation marker ki67, accompanied by a decrease in histone repressive marks. CONCLUSION: The findings suggest that EGCG effectively inhibits PRMT5 and EZH2, underscoring its potential for combined therapeutic strategies in cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：组蛋白甲基转移酶是选择性甲基化组蛋白和非组蛋白上赖氨酸或精氨酸残基的酶，分为赖氨酸甲基转移酶和精氨酸甲基转移酶。值得注意的是，EZH2和PRMT5分别催化H3在K27位的三甲基化和H4在R3位的对称二甲基化。这些甲基化事件被认为是癌症中特征性的组蛋白抑制标记。PRMT5和EZH2的过表达已在多种癌症中报道，并被认定为药物靶点。本研究旨在探讨植物化合物表没食子儿茶素-3-没食子酸酯（EGCG）在乳腺癌模型中对PRMT5和EZH2的抑制潜力。方法：通过结合计算机模拟和体外实验，对一系列植物化合物进行筛选。使用分子对接评估EGCG与人PRMT5：MEP50和EZH2之间的相互作用。通过表面等离子体共振研究验证结合效率，并通过体外甲基化后Western blots、ELISA和细胞实验评估抑制潜力。在细胞系来源的小鼠异种移植模型中评估EGCG的体内功效。结果：EGCG与PRMT5：MEP50复合物和EZH2表现出稳健的相互作用，特别是在SAM结合位点。表面等离子体共振分析显示，在纳摩尔浓度下具有强结合亲和力，尤其是与PRMT5-MEP50相比EZH2。体外实验证实EGCG能抑制PRMT5和EZH2，导致其催化产物H4R3me2s和H3K27me3分别减少。EGCG处理在体外诱导自噬和凋亡。体内研究显示肿瘤大小和增殖标志物ki67显著减少，同时组蛋白抑制标记降低。结论：研究结果表明，EGCG有效抑制PRMT5和EZH2，凸显其在癌症治疗中联合治疗策略的潜力。
